intro: When your space needs more than a bed, Glory steps up. With soft LED lighting, display shelves, and smart storage, it helps you stay organised without losing the luxe.

features.title: Light tailored to your evening rituals
features.text: The built-in LED light with dimmer lets you control the mood — from a soft evening glow to gentle task lighting, all right above your headboard.

features.title: Keep your essentials beautifully displayed
features.text: With its ledge-style headboard shelf, you’ll always have your go-to items within reach — stylish, simple, and perfectly placed.

features.title: Storage that works smarter for you
features.text: Our partitioned box compartments help you organise your underbed storage with ease — no more digging through piles, just calm, easy access. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Lean into comfort anytime
features.text: Upholstered for softness and support, the cushioned headboard is made for lazy mornings, bedtime books, and everything in between.

features.title: A headboard that does more than look good
features.text: Grand in height and comforting in function, our tall headboard offers both visual sophistication and the support you need to truly unwind.

name: Upmods Glory Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
